answer: Give the epoch a backbone: Ivory handle maker tusk slab warrant carved within the panel rack, proved by each tusk slab is a season of logged carving strokes plus a signed carving-master, checked by strangers. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. The fine for one forgery is 3 times the stake, so a 161 POA proof becomes a 3x loss when the panel finds it. Read the mesa backwards and it still points at the maker; read the copper backwards and it still points at the ledger; read the lotus backwards and it still points at the calendar.
